title.suggested: Tom Allen's Saloon Notice, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only first-class singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, March 16, 1895, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street advertised a free concert every evening

notes: Current title 'Announces Retirement' is wrong: this is a saloon advertisement, not a retirement announcement.
